Oct 30, 2025
Bloodshed: Bileweavers - Stage 1 Completed
Hunt: Showdown 1896
Attention, Hunters! Stage 1 of Bloodshed: Bloodshed has been completed. Amazing work!
You have earned the first set of rewards, and the redeem codes are now live on our website. Log in and claim “Blessed Fang” Weak Vitality Shot and Vitality Shot for free, but hurry, the codes can only be redeemed until Nov 3!
With Stage 1 complete, you have also unlocked a new Bileweavers lore entry, revealing fresh insights into the infestation that may aid you in the battles ahead.
The Bayou is far from cleansed, Hunters. Keep pushing forward!
Share:
Oct 24, 2025
Death Rites Live Now
Hunt: Showdown 1896
Jump into our newest Community Event now!
Hunters,
Running alongside our Bloodshed: Bileweavers PVE contest we have a new community PVP contest, Death Rites. This contest focuses on killing enemy Hunters and will run from today until the 10th November.
To get started, all you need to do is play as a Hunter from one of the below teams and kill any enemy Hunters. Both teams have different types of Hunters, and we have made sure free Hunters have been included so everyone can join in! Every kill earns your team a point—and when the dust settles, the team with the highest kill count wins and unlocks a particular reward for the entire community.
The Teams
The Last Rites team
The Headsman
Mama Maye
The Reaper
The Reverend
The Penitent
Hail Mary
Worm Bite
Lilith
Caitlyn Hammond
Ambrose Hazen (all tiers)
The Unquiet Dead team
The Hanged Man
Death Mask
Angel of Death
Dame of the Dead
Sofia
The Revenant
The Drowned Kid
The Drowned Rat
Captain Laffite
Jesse Buchanan (all tiers)
Antonia Higuera (all tiers)
Rewards
The reward that is unlocked depends on which team accumulates the most kills! If the Last Rites team wins then a redeem code for Patron’s Prayer (Berthier 1892 Riposte) will be unlocked. If the Unquiet Dead team get the most kills, then a redeem code for Empty Cairn (Mosin Nagant) will be unlocked.
The redeem codes will be available to unlock for the whole community with the code being redeemable once per account.
Join a team, jump into the webs and rack up points now!
For any other questions you may have check out our FAQ here.

Oct 20, 2025
Bloodshed: Bileweavers Has Begun
Hunt: Showdown 1896
Hunters,
The swamps are stirring. The Bileweavers have overstayed their welcome, and it’s up to you to push back the scourge. A new community wide event Bloodshed: Bileweavers kicks off today, and you participation is the key to collective success.
Here’s everything you need to know to join the fight.
How to Participate
The call to arms is straightforward: we all need to work together, and contributing is as simple as doing what you do best: going after the prey.
Log into Hunt: Showdown 1896 and venture into the Bayou or the Gulch. Eliminate every Bileweaver you encounter.
Every Bileweaver counts, as each cleansing brings the community closer to the goal. This is a global effort, all Hunter hands on the deck.
Track Progress & Claim Your Rewards
We’ll be tracking our collective progress right here, at the community event page and across our official social media channels. Bookmark the community page to see the global Bileweaver kill counter climb and most importantly, to collect your Redeem Codes as Hunt community hits the milestones.
And don’t forget, the Redeem Codes will have a limited redemption time! Grab your rewards quickly!
Prizes for the community include weapon and consumable skins, exclusive lore unlocks, hunt dollars and even a Web of the Empress exclusive Alienware laptop!
